name: 27408 · Greensboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27408 (Greensboro) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27408 (Greensboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27408 (Greensboro) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
